info.name: Lists the contents of a directory in the storage tree.

params.name: projectId
params.description: The unique identifier of the project.

params.name: resourceId
params.description: The unique identifier of the resource.

params.name: OrderBy
params.description:
Gets or sets the field name used for ordering the results.

`Sorting is not yet supported for the file tree endpoint, but this property is included for consistency with other query parameter classes and to allow for future extensibility.`.
Use "asc" or "desc" as the direction.

params.name: Prefix
params.description:
Gets or sets the prefix filter.


The prefix to filter the storage objects by.
Slashes are taken into account when filtering by prefix.
The forwads slash (/) character is treated as the path separator.
The lookup is only done for one level.
To look into the next level, include the trailing slash to indicate the next level of the tree.

params.name: PageNumber
params.description: Gets or sets the desired page number. Should be greater than or equal to 1. Default is 1.

params.name: PageSize
params.description: Gets or sets the desired page size. Should be between 1 and the maximum allowed page size (50). Default is 10.

items.docs: Lists the contents of a directory in the storage tree.
